types.description: Motor circuit breaker / TeSys GV2 (GV2P07) / thermal-magnetic / 3 poles / adjustment 1.6-2.5 A / rotary knob / no accessories

document.title: Schneider Electric / Square D product data sheet GV2P07 - TeSys GV2 Motor circuit breaker, thermal-magnetic, 1.6...2.5 A
document.pages: pp.1–3 exact characteristics; applicable GV2P•• circuit in official GV2P05_DATA SHEET.PDF p.9; exact selection in2017 Section18 p.33

modelingNotes: Exact order GV2P07 confirmed in three Schneider-authored documents: SQD-GV2P07.PDF (iportal.se.com, Dec 06 2017), IE datasheet GV2P07_DATASHEET (Jul 27 2023), and US Digest 0100CT1501 Sec.18 Table 18.123 (1.6-2.5 A -> GV2P07). Manufacturer spelling is GV2P07 (no hyphen); the GV2-P07 hyphen in the source/job is a presentation separator, not a variant. No successor substituted.
TeSys GV2 3-pole thermal-magnetic motor circuit breaker with rotary operator. SQD sheet: 'Control type: Rotary knob'; IE datasheet: 'rotary handle'. Matches source 'operating with rotary knob'.

Three poles are mechanically linked (single rotary operator, common thermal-magnetic trip): modeled as ganged_with. Poles are switching contacts and do NOT form permanent conductive joins; no fixed links are declared.

Ratings (capabilities, with conditions): thermal adjustment 1.6-2.5 A (In up to 2.5 A) conforming to IEC 60947-4-1; fixed magnetic tripping current 33.5 A (approx. 13x In upper); Ue 690 V AC 50/60 Hz, Ui 690 V, Uimp 6 kV; Icu 100 kA at 230/240/400/415/440/500 V and 8 kA at 690 V (IEC 60947-2); phase-failure sensitivity yes; suitability for isolation yes; power dissipation 2.5 W/pole; 100 000 cycles.

rating.nominal_voltage is intentionally left unassigned on terminals: the device is multi-voltage (rated up to 690 V AC, usable 230-690 V). 690 V AC is the maximum capability recorded here, not an assigned circuit voltage. terminals carry voltage_type AC (device is AC / AC-3). current 2.5 A on terminals is the adjustment upper bound, not a trip setting or conductor ampacity.

Connections: screw clamp terminals, 2 conductors 1-6 mm2 solid / 1.5-6 mm2 flexible / 1-4 mm2 with ferrule, tightening 1.7 N.m. 35 mm DIN-rail (clip) or panel (2x M4). 89 x 45 x 97 mm, dark grey, IP20, IK04. These conditional installation limits are documentation, not automated conductor checks.

No auxiliary contacts, undervoltage/shunt releases, or fault/position-signaling contacts are part of the GV2P07 base order; those are separate add-on orders (e.g. GVAE1, GVAE11, GVAN11, GVAE20, GVAN20, GVAU/GVAS/GVAD releases, GVAM signaling, GV2AK00). GV2P07 has no protective-earth terminal; panel/enclosure bonding is external and not a device pin.
Trip curves, short-circuit/backup coordination, group-motor and UL 508 Type E/F application (line-side barrier GV2GH7) are not evaluated.

Coordinator visually inspected the explicitly labeled GV2P•• connection diagram on physical page9 of the official GV2P05 data sheet. It directly establishes the GV2P main terminal scheme 1/L1–2/T1,3/L2–4/T2,5/L3–6/T3 with three mechanically ganged switched poles; exact GV2P07 identity and1.6–2.5 A setting remain established by the exact product data and Section18 Table18.123. The unrelated GV7R diagram is not used as terminal evidence. https://iportal.se.com/Contents/docs/GV2P05_DATA%20SHEET.PDF

connectionCoverage.notes: All six main power terminals of the three poles are declared; this is the entire electrical interface of the GV2P07 base device. No protective-earth terminal exists on the device, and no auxiliary/release/signaling contacts are part of this order (separate GVA*/GV2AK00 accessories).
